This '''moon''' was located in the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], traveled to the Rift to find the [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] [[Species/Legends|species]], in hopes of learning more about Jedi Knight-turned-[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo's]] fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. They were found by [[Tadar'Ro]], who took them to this [[Moon/Legends|moon]] to see if they could pass the challenge of communicating to him through the Force then allow them access to the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Aing-Tii. Luke Skywalker passed, and Tadar'Ro took them to [[Aing-Tii homeworld|his homeworld]].

The moon was rocky and had an [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]-[[Nitrogen/Legends|nitrogen]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].
